intro: Syral Bladeleaf is a night elf resident of Dolanaar in Teldrassil who serves as a liaison for the Council of the Forest. She guides young adventurers who arrive from Shadowglen, directing them toward local caretakers, herbalists, and elders who watch over the crown's delicate boughs.

p: Found standing near the heart of Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf helps organize local affairs in the shadow of Teldrassil's canopy. Acting on behalf of the Council of the Forest, she directs newly arrived night elves to community leaders and herbalists across the village and the nearby wilderness. Through her guidance, travelers connect with the botanist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth and replenish supplies for the village elders.

Syral works on behalf of the Council of the Forest in Dolanaar. Her responsibilities keep her focused on communal welfare, ensuring that medicinal elixirs reach those in need and that any disruptions in the local ecosystem receive swift attention.
